title: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector takes its spawn flags from windowless_spawn, so none of its subprocess calls opens a console window
intention: Every subprocess spawn in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector (inspector.py, no_iou_stands.py) takes its keywords from cairn.tools.windowless_spawn, so none opens a visible console window on Windows.
why: Akien 2026-11-20: popups while he works on the same box are annoying and sometimes interrupt his typing. Measured 2026-11-20 on akiendell: 2 non-proof file(s) in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector (inspector.py, no_iou_stands.py) call subprocess with neither detached_kwargs nor windowless_kwargs, and the scan that guards the helper looks only for Popen. This is cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector's share of the sweep under 364704f371dd.
traces_to: CP4 (the system serves the person at the box); Law 4 (the widened scan enforces it); Rule 1 (the build lives inside its own component).
how: In each named file, pass windowless_kwargs() (the caller waits) or detached_kwargs() (the child outlives it) to every subprocess call, importing from cairn.tools.windowless_spawn.windowless_spawn; a call that must show a terminal keeps none and carries a marker comment. Red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_build_inspector_takes_its_spawn_flags_from_the_helper.py asserts unhelped_sites over cairn/devices/codemother/machines/build_inspector names nothing.

decisions.text: D1: every subprocess call in inspector.py, no_iou_stands.py takes the helper's keywords (clause 1).
